sentences.text: Ferganocephale is currently classified as a dubious genus of neornithischian dinosaur, a group of ornithischians with bird-like hips.

The species Ferganocephale adenticulatum was first described by Averianov, Martin, and Bakirov in 2005 from the Middle Jurassic Balabansai Svita of Kyrgyzstan. The only known fossils are teeth from this formation in the Fergana Valley, dating to the Callovian stage between 165.3 and 161.5 million years ago.

Ferganocephale was originally placed in the family Pachycephalosauridae, but in 2006, Robert M. Sullivan disputed this classification, arguing the specimens were too incomplete and lacked characteristic tooth serrations.
A 2024 analysis found Ferganocephale morphologically similar to Chaoyangsauridae but excluded it from that clade due to a lack of denticles and strong cingulum.
